notes.title: The Secrets of Jesus is released!
notes.notes:
The Secrets of Jesus is now released! And it's 10% off for the first week.

I am so thankful for your patience, encouragement and support.
I put my heart and "soul?" into this game. I hope you like and enjoy it. 
And please don't forget to leave a review if you like it. I STILL NEED YOUR SUPPORT.

Jesus and I love you!
